$comment: Accessibility ratchet baseline for a11y.spec.ts: serious and critical axe violations per page state, theme and rule. Each state is scanned in the dark and the light theme: /notes and /chat at 1280x720, and the extension side panel's chat at 420x900. A new rule or a higher node count fails; so does a lower count or a missing rule, until this file is updated. See e2e/ux-regression/README.md. Empty since #3124 (AX-07, AX-16): the eight color-contrast nodes per notes state were antd primary buttons (white on #517bdc), the antd link colour and the antd 6 Select placeholder (.ant-select-placeholder, coloured by colorTextPlaceholder), and the target-size node was the 11x11 'Tags help' button; the theme token and 24x24 help-button fixes cover all of them. The light-theme and side-panel scans were added empty (#3124 follow-up): none of these states renders the light status and primary /10 tints that read 3.6-4.4:1, so themes/__tests__/text-on-tint-contrast.test.ts guards those.
